== Notes ==
* In [[Nightfall]] this skill becomes unlocked after recruiting either [[Margrid the Sly]] or [[Acolyte Jin]], then it can be learned using a [[skill tome]].
* The arrow leaves the bow {{1/4}} seconds into this skill's activation, as [[attack skill]]s hit halfway through their stated [[activation time]].
* This skill has a {{3/4}} second [[aftercast delay]].
* Skills will not be disabled if they are [[easily interrupted]] (including [[Dazed]]) or interrupted by an effect such as [[Choking Gas]] or [[Spinal Shivers]], as those trigger before Distracting Shot takes effect.
* Distracting Shot will not disable a skill that is prevented from being interrupted.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the [[Game updates/20080529#Bug Fixes 2|May 29, 2008 game update]], this skill received no bonus damage from some preparations.
